The user asked on 2026-11-20 to "work on a1+ Unit 5 same all deal as before none stop all approved": A1+ 5.Y follows A1 5.Y with one step each, straight to Preview in batches, Gemini 2.5 Flash photos and ElevenLabs audio pre-approved, no per-lesson gates, reviewed in Preview. Five one-person photos: Ana at the fridge with an empty milk bottle, Luis after a run with an empty water bottle, Diego at a café counter pointing at a sandwich, Sofia with raw chicken and an empty pot, Luis at a bakery window. Reply cards ask What do you want/need to do? in a voice other than the answerer's.

lesson.title: 5.6 I want to eat a sandwich
lesson.unit_outcome: Say how much and how many, offer and order food and drinks politely, agree about likes, say what you want and need to do, talk about meals, prices and what is in your food, compare prices, use numbers to ninety-nine and ask for things at the table.
lesson.lesson_title: I want to eat a sandwich
lesson.sub_lesson_title: I want to eat a sandwich
lesson.goal: Say what you want or need to do with want to / need to + a verb (I want to drink water. / Ana needs to buy milk.) and ask What do you want to do?
lesson.grammar_function: A follow-up of A1 5.6 Wants and Needs: A1 wants or needs a thing (She wants water. He needs bread.); A1+ 5.6 puts to + a verb after want and need (Ana needs to buy milk. / I want to drink water.), with A1's he/she -s on wants and needs and the plain verb after to. The photos show the situation (an empty milk bottle at the fridge, an empty water bottle after a run, a sandwich behind a café counter, a raw chicken and an empty pot, a cake in a bakery window); want and need cannot be photographed, so they are set against each other only in Listen.
lesson.prerequisite: A1 5.6 want(s), need(s); A1 5.2-5.3 eat, drink; A1 5.11 buy; A1+ 1.2 cook; A1 5.13 sandwich, A1 5.14 cake.
lesson.speaking_outcome: Join want to (WAN-tuh) and need to (NEED-tuh) with a short to; do not require native-like speed.
